## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

summary(penguins)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(meanBillLength = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))  |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = species, y = meanBillLength, fill = species)
  ) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Bill Length for Each Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Mean Bill Length",
    fill = "Species Color"
  )

```
